title: Dispatchers return their delivery verdict; a dead-lettered offer is not out
deviations_from_card: Shrunk: pipeline-entry-action.test.ts and comms-dispatch-population.test.ts needed no change (their stubs/assertions compile and pass against the widened type). sendCandidateComm returns DispatchOutcome (adds `status` so the OutboxStatus-returning dispatchers pass it on via `.status`). dispatchInterviewReminder keeps Promise<void> (widening it breaks a typed stub in interview-reminders.test.ts, outside the write set) but its interview_reminder_sent event is gated on delivered() like the others. dispatchOutcome maps inline rather than importing comms-truth.deliveryClaim for value: that import added one module to every comms-sending route graph and tripped perf-budget; the type import is free. Case 5 (keyless) is a keep-green guard and passed before; case 4 was made red-before by asserting the approval survives the dead letter.
notes: tsc: whole-tree red only on sibling in-flight paths (analytics-deltas.test, db/pipeline.ts reopened, devcase liveWork*/session-key tests, usePipelineBulk.ts); zero errors on my files. Full test:unit exit 1: BROKEN = python-runner-concurrency (process-tree kill timing, unrelated to comms), devcase-candidate-refusals, devcase-flush-guards, rate-limit-contract (devcase session routes - sibling), usePipelineBulk (sibling); FLAKEs pipeline-event-reasons + pipeline-store passed alone, liveWork* sibling. All 418 tests in comms*/pipeline-entry-action*/screen-wave*/pipeline-approval-cas/offer*/interview-reminder*/automation*/pipeline-command* pass. test:perf exit 1 on the shared tree, but base 159cdbae3 + my three source files alone (git archive into scratch, check-budget.mjs) is `within budget` - the KB overage comes from siblings' uncommitted files. automation-run.ts was NOT touched (a sibling has it modified); it already keys off extendDraftedOffer's status, so the dead-letter fix reaches it. planWaveReversal contract kept: rejection_sent still means notified; a dead letter now writes rejection_comms_failed (a trail kind), so the undo reports notified:false truthfully.
